treeCoordinateAudit.positionMeaning: Unaltered source points; CRS agreement is not a field survey or proof of current presence.

buildingCoverage.typeRule: Open buildings, canopies, construction sites, greenhouses and unrecognized types remain uncertain; never solid shade prisms.
buildingCoverage.limitations: 2019 geometry; flat extrusions; no terrain or tree shadows. Source coverage is not field validation.
buildingCoverage.noGroundRule: Source XY convex hulls without GroundSurface are unknown masks; 150 m is the conservative supported model ceiling, never a measured height. Ground reference stays null.

municipalCoverage.clearanceRule: Whole-edge lower bound: min(endpoint clearance) minus half edge length; source clearance rounded down with an additional 1 m guard. Shade requires clearance >= maximum model shadow reach.
municipalCoverage.limitations: Municipal boundary is a conservative data limit, not a field survey or a claim of complete current buildings.

provenance.treeSource: City of Zurich Bauminventar, source locations 2021, heights 2018; preparation 2022

traffic.note: Current-status zones; absent individual implementation dates retained as unknown. Catalogue/fetch dates are not traffic observations. No vehicle counts, live traffic or noise model. Major-road proximity uses OSM class and matching recorded level.

vehicleCounts.note: Directional measurement totals are already aggregated over detectors. No sum across counters; no imputed or missing values. Annual same-weekday/hour means, not live counts or forecasts. Public source may revise past observations.

pilotExclusions.reason: Historical measuring point >300 m from current site

vehicleCounts.ranking: Counts are point observations with incomplete street coverage. Street-context ranking is retained; absent counters are never treated as zero traffic.

addresses.positionMeaning: Map-label positions from official surveying; not verified entrances or a guarantee of public access. Runtime snaps to the public walking graph within 45 m or explains why it cannot route.
addresses.freshness: Snapshot, not live search. Catalogue/fetch dates do not establish the individual survey date.

detailedShade.note: Real 3D roofs/facades with LiDAR receiver elevations in a bounded central pilot. No tree or terrain occlusion.
